subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Friendship is one of i. existing between two similar i. between hearts (b) It is a relation minds ii. and like-minded persons (c) Since sincerity and loyalty ii. and other relevant aspects iii. to develop or establish (d) It is an intimacy or an belonging to this lead a man friendship acquaintance iii. the noblest expressions iv. of human relationship and (e) Confidence, love, sacrifice, iv. are the foundation of instincts fellow- feeling, mental state friendship v. it is a boon and divine gift. v. which exists
guide_solution: (a) Friendship is one of the noblest expressions of human relationship and instincts. (b) It is a relation which exists between hearts. (c) Since sincerity and loyalty are the foundation of friendship it is a boon and divine gift. (d) It is an intimacy or an acquaintance existing between two similar minds and like-minded persons. (e) Confidence, love, sacrifice, fellow-feeling, mental state and other relevant aspects belonging to this lead a man to develop or establish friendship. → → → → → → →
